projects.acc.intro: As a **Senior PHP Developer**, I was responsible for the core architecture and full-stack implementation of key modules.
projects.acc.li1: Engineered a robust **Stripe integration** supporting recurring billing, dynamic add-ons, and prorated adjustment logic.
projects.acc.li2: Implemented highly reactive frontend dashboards using **Livewire** and **Tailwind CSS**, providing real-time data updates without page reloads.
projects.acc.li3: Designed secure multi-tenant database schemas to ensure data isolation and high performance under heavy transaction loads.
projects.acc.li4: Containerized the application using **Docker Compose**, streamlining local development and production deployment workflows.
projects.acc.feature1_desc: Separate payment triggers for additional services that adjust monthly billing cycles.
projects.acc.feature2_desc: Live Dashboards for tracking subscription health, Churn, and MRR.
projects.acc.feature3_desc: Restful API integration for third-party accounting software synchronization.
projects.acc.feature4_desc: Hands-off management of invoices, receipts, and failed payment recovery.
projects.autofill.intro: As the **Lead Developer**, I architected the extension for Manifest V3, focusing on performance, cross-browser compatibility, and robust security.
projects.autofill.li1: **MV3 Architecture**: Implemented a scalable messaging system between background service workers, content scripts, and page configurations.
projects.autofill.li2: **Smart Matching Engine**: Developed an algorithm that identifies fields using on-the-fly analysis of IDs, names, placeholders, and ARIA labels.
projects.autofill.li3: **Security First**: Replaced all dynamic rendering with safe DOM manipulations (createElement, textContent) to completely eliminate XSS risks.
projects.autofill.li4: **Privacy Core**: Built a local-only storage system using `chrome.storage.local` to ensure user data remains isolated and secure.
projects.autofill.feature1_desc: Identifies fields not only by ID, but also via placeholders, labels, and customizable keyword lists.
projects.autofill.feature2_desc: Built with TypeScript for type safety and Vite for optimized, high-performance builds.
projects.autofill.feature3_desc: Zero external data transfer. All input data is stored locally in the browser's isolated storage.
projects.autofill.feature4_desc: Interface utilizes Firefox System Colors to seamlessly match the browser's native theme (Dark/Light).
projects.autofill.validation: Passed Mozilla's "web-ext lint" validation with zero errors. Optimized for Gecko engine specifications.

projects.believe.li2: **React Frontend**: Contributed to the React-based frontend, implementing critical UI fixes and component optimizations.
projects.believe.li3: **Performance Tuning**: Improved data handling performance, leading to faster app load times and smoother navigation for users.
projects.believe.feature1_desc: Fixed critical billing loop issues that affected user retention.

projects.kohana.feature1_desc: Redundant API call logic to ensure constant data access even during primary provider downtime.

projects.silencemap.li1: **Architecture**: Engineered the application using **React** and **TypeScript**, ensuring strict type safety and high performance for complex GIS data.
projects.silencemap.li2: **Acoustic Mapping**: Implemented algorithms for processing and visualizing noise-level data across urban landscapes.
projects.silencemap.li3: **Noise-aware Routing**: Developed custom routing logic that prioritizes "quiet paths" for pedestrians and cyclists in smart cities.
projects.silencemap.feature1_desc: Seamless handling of large-scale geographic data sets for real-time visualization.
projects.silencemap.feature2_desc: Custom logic for interpolating noise data points into a continuous urban heatmap.
projects.special.intro: As a **Full Stack PHP Developer**, I led the modernization and feature expansion of the existing Kohana-based platform.

projects.special.li3: **SSO & Testing**: Implemented Single Sign-On (SSO) and a high-security automated course testing and certification system.
